title: Rama becomes angry at the ocean
introduction: The careless ocean did not appear in his personal form to Rama, even when it was requested to do so. Rama becomes angry at the ocean and looses fierce arrows, which cause a terror among the creatures inhabiting the sea.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे एकविंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 21th Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
ततः सागरवेलायाम् दर्भानास्तीर्य राघवः |
अञ्जलिम् प्राङ्मुखः कृत्वा प्रतिशिश्ये महोदधेः
बाहुम् भुजङ्गभोगाभमुपधायारिसूदनः |
verses.iast:
tataḥ sāgaravelāyām darbhānāstīrya rāghavaḥ |
aJṇjalim prāṇ^mukhaḥ kṛtvā pratiśiśye mahodadheḥ
bāhum bhujaṇ^gabhogābhamupadhāyārisūdanaḥ |
verses.translation: Thereafter Rama, the annihilator of enemies, spreading sacred grass on the sea shore, making a respectful salutation (by joining his palms) to the great ocean with his face turned eastward, lied down with his arm, resembling the body of a snake , as his pillow.

glosses.meaning: a respectful salutation(by joining his palms)
having his face turned east ward
resembling of the body of the snake

verses.devanagari:
मणिकाञ्चनकेयूरमुक्ताप्रवरभूषणैः
भुजैः परमनारीणामभिमृष्टमनेकधा
verses.iast:
maṇikāJṇcanakeyūramuktāpravarabhūṣaṇaiḥ
bhujaiḥ paramanārīṇāmabhimṛṣṭamanekadhā
verses.translation: His arm formerly adorned with armlets of gems and gold and the most excellent jewels of pearls, was touched more than once, by excellent women ( Kausalya and other mothers or by royal maids).

glosses.meaning: adorned with armlets of gems and gold and the most excellent jewels of pearls
by excellent women (by Kausalya and other mothers or by royal maids.)

verses.devanagari:
चन्दनागुरुभिश्चैव पुरस्तादभिसेवितम्
बालसूर्यप्रकाशैश्च चन्दनैरुपशोभितम् |
verses.iast:
candanāgurubhiścaiva purastādabhisevitam
bālasūryaprakāśaiśca candanairupaśobhitam |
verses.translation: Formerly, his arm used to be tended with sandalwood and aloe and with saffron pastes and made beautiful like the splendor of a rising sun.

glosses.meaning: resembling the splendor of a rising sun.

verses.devanagari:
शयने चोत्तमाङ्गेन सीतायाः शोभितम् पुरा
तक्षकस्येव सम्भोगम् गङ्गाजलनिषेवितम् |
verses.iast:
śayane cottamāṇ^gena sītāyāḥ śobhitam purā
takśakasyeva sambhogam gaṇ^gājalaniṣevitam |
verses.translation: In the past, the aforesaid arm was graced by the head of Seetha on the couch. It resembled the body of Takshaka. (A snake) supported on the water of the Ganga.

glosses.meaning: like the body of Takshaka (A snake)
supported on the water of the Ganga.

verses.devanagari:
सम्गे युगसम्काशम् शत्रूणाम् शोकवर्धनम् |
सुह्ऱ्^दाम् नन्दनम् दीर्घम् सागरान्तव्यपाश्रयम् |
verses.iast:
samge yugasamkāśam śatrūṇām śokavardhanam |
suhR^dām nandanam dīrgham sāgarāntavyapāśrayam |
verses.translation: The aforesaid arm resembled a yoke. It enhanced the grief of his enemies in battle. It was delightful to his friends. It is now placed at the shore of the sea.

glosses.meaning: is placed at the shore of the sea.

verses.devanagari:
अस्यता च पुनः सव्यम् ज्याघातविगतत्वचम् |
दक्षिणो कक्षिणम् बहुम् महापरिघसम्निभम्
गोसहस्रप्रदातारम् ह्युपधाय भुजम् महत् |
अद्य मे मरणम् वाथ तरणम् सागरस्य वा
इति रामो धृतिम् कृत्वा महाबाहुर्महोदधिम् |
अधिशिश्ये च विधिवत्प्रयतोऽत्र स्थितो मुनिः
verses.iast:
asyatā ca punaḥ savyam jyāghātavigatatvacam |
dakśiṇo kakśiṇam bahum mahāparighasamnibham
gosahasrapradātāram hyupadhāya bhujam mahat |
adya me maraṇam vātha taraṇam sāgarasya vā
iti rāmo dhṛtim kṛtvā mahābāhurmahodadhim |
adhiśiśye ca vidhivatprayato'tra sthito muniḥ
verses.translation: The aforesaid arm whose skin had been hardened by the strokes of the bow string, off the left arm resembling a great mace and that mighty right arm that bestowed thousands of cows in charity was used as a pillow. Rama, the competent man and the mighty armed said: " Either crossing of the ocean or a death should occur to me today". Making that resolve he laid down by the ocean, restraining his speech and with a pious disposition according to tradition.

glosses.meaning: whose skin had been hardened by the strokes of the bow string
that bestowed thousands of cows in charity

verses.devanagari:
तस्य रामस्य सुप्तस्य कुश आस्तीर्णे मही तले |
नियमाद् अप्रमत्तस्य निशास् तिस्रो अतिचक्रमुः
verses.iast:
tasya rāmasya suptasya kuśa āstīrṇe mahī tale |
niyamād apramattasya niśās tisro aticakramuḥ
verses.translation: Following the scriptural injunction, that Rama who was devoted to his sacred vow, while sleeping on the ground spread with Kusha grass, spent a time of three nights there.

verses.devanagari:
स त्रिरात्रोषितस्तत्र नयज्ञो धर्मवत्सलः |
उपासत तदा रामः सागरम् सरिताम् पतिम्
verses.iast:
sa trirātroṣitastatra nayajJṇo dharmavatsalaḥ |
upāsata tadā rāmaḥ sāgaram saritām patim
verses.translation: Remaining there for three nights, Rama who was skilled in policy and fond of piety, waited upon the ocean, the lord of rivers.

verses.devanagari:
न च दर्शयते मन्दस् तदा रामस्य सागरः |
प्रयतेन अपि रामेण यथा अर्हम् अभिपूजितः
verses.iast:
na ca darśayate mandas tadā rāmasya sāgaraḥ |
prayatena api rāmeṇa yathā arham abhipūjitaḥ
verses.translation: Though honored according to his worth by the self subdued Rama, the careless ocean did not appear in his personal form to Rama.

verses.devanagari:
समुद्रस्य ततः क्रुद्धो रामो रक्त अन्त लोचनः |
समीपस्थम् उवाच इदम् लक्ष्मणम् शुभ लक्ष्मणम्
verses.iast:
samudrasya tataḥ kruddho rāmo rakta anta locanaḥ |
samīpastham uvāca idam lakṣmaṇam śubha lakṣmaṇam
verses.translation: Rama becoming angry with the ocean, having the outer corners of his eyes turned red, spoke those words to Lakshmana, having auspicious marks, who was in his vicinity:

glosses.meaning: with the outer corners of his eyes turned red

verses.devanagari:
अवलेपम् समुद्रस्य न दर्शयति यत् स्वयम् |
प्रशमः च क्षमा चैव आर्जवम् प्रिय वादिता
असामर्थ्यम् फलन्ति एते निर्गुणेषु सताम् गुणाः |
verses.iast:
avalepam samudrasya na darśayati yat svayam |
praśamaḥ ca kṣamā caiva ārjavam priya vāditā
asāmarthyam phalanti ete nirguṇeṣu satām guṇāḥ |
verses.translation: "O, what arrogance of the ocean, who does not appear himself personally before me! Indeed calmness, forbearance kind spoken ness and straight -forwardness- these qualities of noble men give weak results, when directed towards those having no virtues."

glosses.meaning: when directed towards those having no virtues.

verses.devanagari:
आत्म प्रशंसिनम् दुष्टम् धृष्टम् विपरिधावकम्
सर्वत्र उत्सृष्ट दण्डम् च लोकः सत् कुरुते नरम् |
verses.iast:
ātma praśaṃsinam duṣṭam dhṛṣṭam viparidhāvakam
sarvatra utsṛṣṭa daṇḍam ca lokaḥ sat kurute naram |
verses.translation: "This world honors that man, who boasts himself, is corrupt and shameless, runs about in all directions advertising himself and commits every kind of excess"

glosses.meaning: like a horse set at liberty.

verses.devanagari:
न साम्ना शक्यते कीर्तिर् न साम्ना शक्यते यशः
प्राप्तुम् लक्ष्मण लोके अस्मिन् जयो वा रण मूधनि |
verses.iast:
na sāmnā śakyate kīrtir na sāmnā śakyate yaśaḥ
prāptum lakṣmaṇa loke asmin jayo vā raṇa mūdhani |
verses.translation: "O, Lakshmana! In this world, it is not possible to obtain fame, glory or victory at the end of a battle, by conciliation"

verses.devanagari:
अद्य मद् बाण निर्भिन्नैर् मकरैर् मकर आलयम् |
निरुद्ध तोयम् सौमित्रे प्लवद्भिः पश्य सर्वतः
verses.iast:
adya mad bāṇa nirbhinnair makarair makara ālayam |
niruddha toyam saumitre plavadbhiḥ paśya sarvataḥ
verses.translation: "O, Lakshmana! Behold now this ocean, having its water made suffocated soon with its crocodiles floated on all sides and broken asunder by my arrows".

glosses.meaning: and broken asunder by my arrows.

verses.devanagari:
भोगामः च पश्य नागानाम् मया भिन्नानि लक्ष्मण
महाभोगानि मत्स्यानाम् करिणाम् च करान् इह |
verses.iast:
bhogāmḥ ca paśya nāgānām mayā bhinnāni lakṣmaṇa
mahābhogāni matsyānām kariṇām ca karān iha |
verses.translation: "See here, O, Lakshmana, the coils of water snakes, the huge bodies of alligators and the trunks of sea elephants being shattered by me."

verses.devanagari:
सशन्ख शुक्तिका जालम् समीन मकरम् शरैः
अद्य युद्धेन महता समुद्रम् परिशोषये |
verses.iast:
saśankha śuktikā jālam samīna makaram śaraiḥ
adya yuddhena mahatā samudram pariśoṣaye |
verses.translation: "I will make the ocean with its multitude of conches, oyster shells, fishes and crocodiles, dry up now in this great battle"

glosses.meaning: I will make the ocean dry up

verses.devanagari:
क्षमया हि समायुक्तम् माम् अयम् मकर आलयः
असमर्थम् विजानाति धिक् क्षमाम् ईदृशे जने |
verses.iast:
kṣamayā hi samāyuktam mām ayam makara ālayaḥ
asamartham vijānāti dhik kṣamām īdṛśe jane |
verses.translation: "This ocean is considering me as an incapable man endowed as I am with forbearance. It is a great mistake to show forbearance to such an individual."

verses.devanagari:
स दर्शयति साम्ना मे सागरो रूपमात्मनः
चापम् आनय सौमित्रे शरामः च आशी विष उपमान् |
समुद्रम् शोषयिष्यामि पद्भ्याम् यान्तु प्लवङ्गमाः
verses.iast:
sa darśayati sāmnā me sāgaro rūpamātmanaḥ
cāpam ānaya saumitre śarāmḥ ca āśī viṣa upamān |
samudram śoṣayiṣyāmi padbhyām yāntu plavaṇ^gamāḥ
verses.translation: "The Ocean is not appearing himself before me on kind words. O, Lakshmana! Bring the bow and the serpentine arrows. I shall dry up this ocean, so that our monkeys can cross it by feet."

glosses.meaning: I shall dry up this ocean

verses.devanagari:
अद्य अक्षोभ्यम् अपि क्रुद्धः क्षोभयिष्यामि सागरम् |
वेलासु कृत मर्यादम् सहसा ऊर्मि समाकुलम्
निर्मर्यादम् करिष्यामि सायकैर् वरुण आलयम् |
महार्णवम् क्षोBहयिष्ये महादानवसम्कुलम्
verses.iast:
adya akṣobhyam api kruddhaḥ kṣobhayiṣyāmi sāgaram |
velāsu kṛta maryādam sahasā ūrmi samākulam
nirmaryādam kariṣyāmi sāyakair varuṇa ālayam |
mahārṇavam kśoBhayiṣye mahādānavasamkulam
verses.translation: "Being provoked now, I will shake this ocean, even if it is unshakable. I will force the ocean, which is demarcated by banks and agitated with thousands of waves, bereft of a boundary, by my arrows. I will agitate the great ocean, thronged with great demons."

glosses.meaning: and agitated with thousands of waves

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्त्वा धनुष् पाणिः क्रोध विस्फारित ईक्षणः |
बभूव रामो दुर्धर्षो युग अन्त अग्निर् इव ज्वलन्
verses.iast:
evam uktvā dhanuṣ pāṇiḥ krodha visphārita īkṣaṇaḥ |
babhūva rāmo durdharṣo yuga anta agnir iva jvalan
verses.translation: Speaking as aforesaid, Rama with his eyes made larger by anger and wielding a bow with his hand, became dreadful to look at, as a blazing fire at the end of the world.

glosses.meaning: = with his eyes made larger by anger
and wielding a bow with his hand
like a blazing fire at the end of the world.

verses.devanagari:
सम्पीड्य च धनुर् घोरम् कम्पयित्वा शरैर् जगत् |
मुमोच विशिखान् उग्रान् वज्राणि इव शत क्रतुः
verses.iast:
sampīḍya ca dhanur ghoram kampayitvā śarair jagat |
mumoca viśikhān ugrān vajrāṇi iva śata kratuḥ
verses.translation: Swaying his terrific bow and making the earth tremble by his violence Rama released the arrow resembling a powerful thunderbolt of Indra. (god of celestials).

verses.devanagari:
ते ज्वलन्तो महावेगास् तेजसा सायक उत्तमाः |
प्रविशन्ति समुद्रस्य सलिलम् त्रस्त पन्नगम्
verses.iast:
te jvalanto mahāvegās tejasā sāyaka uttamāḥ |
praviśanti samudrasya salilam trasta pannagam
verses.translation: Those excellent arrows having a great speed and ablaze by their splendor, penetrated the waters of the ocean, striking the water- snakes with terror.

verses.devanagari:
ततो वेगः समुद्रस्य सनक्र मकरो महान् |
स बभूव महाघोरः समारुत रवस् तदा
verses.iast:
tato vegaḥ samudrasya sanakra makaro mahān |
sa babhūva mahāghoraḥ samāruta ravas tadā
verses.translation: The great jerk of water with fishes and alligators of the ocean, together with the resonance of the wind became very much dreadful.

glosses.meaning: together with the resonance of the wind

verses.devanagari:
महाऊर्मि माला विततः शन्ख शुक्ति समाकुलः |
सधूम परिवृत्त ऊर्मिः सहसा अभून् महाउदधिः
verses.iast:
mahāūrmi mālā vitataḥ śankha śukti samākulaḥ |
sadhūma parivṛtta ūrmiḥ sahasā abhūn mahāudadhiḥ
verses.translation: Immediately that great ocean, became shaken by the cluster of huge waves enveloped by a multitude of conches in its rolling waves and a smoke came out.

glosses.meaning: shaken by a multitude of huge waves
enveloped by a multitude of couches

verses.devanagari:
व्यथिताः पन्नगाः च आसन् दीप्त आस्या दीप्त लोचनाः |
दानवाः च महावीर्याः पाताल तल वासिनः
verses.iast:
vyathitāḥ pannagāḥ ca āsan dīpta āsyā dīpta locanāḥ |
dānavāḥ ca mahāvīryāḥ pātāla tala vāsinaḥ
verses.translation: Sea-snakes having brilliant faces and glittering eyes and the very valiant demons residing in nethermost subterranean region of the sea, were perturbed.

verses.devanagari:
ऊर्मयः सिन्धु राजस्य सनक्र मकरास् तदा |
विन्ध्य मन्दर सम्काशाः समुत्पेतुः सहस्रशः
verses.iast:
ūrmayaḥ sindhu rājasya sanakra makarās tadā |
vindhya mandara samkāśāḥ samutpetuḥ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: Thousands of waves, so large resembling Vindhya and Mandhara mountains, jumped up from the sea with its crocodiles and sea monsters.

glosses.meaning: with its crocodiles and sea monsters.

verses.devanagari:
आघूर्णित तरन्ग ओघः सम्ब्भ्रान्त उरग राक्षसः |
उद्वर्तित महाग्राहः सम्वृत्तः सलिल आशयः
verses.iast:
āghūrṇita taranga oghaḥ sambbhrānta uraga rākṣasaḥ |
udvartita mahāgrāhaḥ samvṛttaḥ salila āśayaḥ
verses.translation: That ocean with its multitude of fluctuating waves, with its frightened serpents and demons, with huge crocodiles coming out, became full of noise.

glosses.meaning: with its multitude of fluctuating waves
with its frightened serpents and demons
with huge crocodiles caused to come out

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तु तम् राघव मुग्रवेगम् |
प्रकर्षमाणम् ध्मरप्रमेयम् |
सौमित्रिरुत्पत्य विनिःश्वसन्तम् |
मामेति चोक्त्वा धनुराललम्बे
verses.iast:
tatastu tam rāghava mugravegam |
prakarṣamāṇam dhmaraprameyam |
saumitrirutpatya viniḥśvasantam |
māmeti coktvā dhanurālalambe
verses.translation: Then Lakshmana rushed towards Rama who in a terrific velocity was stretching his incomparable bow, with a penetrating sigh, crying: "No further, no farther" and took hold of the bow.

verses.devanagari:
एतद्विनापि ह्युदधेस्तवार्य |
सम्पत्स्यते वीरतमस्य कार्यम् |
भवद्विधाः क्रोधवशम् न यान्ति |
दीर्घम् भवान्पश्यतु साधुवृत्तम्
verses.iast:
etadvināpi hyudadhestavārya |
sampatsyate vīratamasya kāryam |
bhavadvidhāḥ krodhavaśam na yānti |
dīrgham bhavānpaśyatu sādhuvṛttam
verses.translation: "O, honorable man! Even without the destruction of the ocean, the purpose of you the greatest hero will be fulfilled. Men like you do not fall into the sway of anger. You see some durable and noble alternative"

verses.devanagari:
अन्तर्हितैश्चापि तथान्तरिक्षे |
ब्रह्मर्षिभिश्चैव सुरर्षिभिश्च |
शब्दः कृतः कष्टमिति ब्रुवद्भि |
र्मा मेति चोक्त्वा महता स्वरेण
verses.iast:
antarhitaiścāpi tathāntarikśe |
brahmarṣibhiścaiva surarṣibhiśca |
śabdaḥ kṛtaḥ kaṣṭamiti bruvadbhi |
rmā meti coktvā mahatā svareṇa
verses.translation: Brahmana-sages and celestial sages, stationed in the interior of the sky cried in a loud voices, saying "No farther, no farther" and making a noise "Ah,Oh,Alas!"
